theorems.name: Submission.dorag_haa_l2_pairing_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (W g : Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ j, MemLp (f j) 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R))) → MemLp W 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) → MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, (f j x - W x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, f j x * g x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, W x * g x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
